headline: Foundation models and benchmarks advance transcriptomic integration, deconvolution and…
label: Transcriptomics Analysis Tools And Benchmarks
summary: Recent work couples single-cell transcriptomics with larger-scale data repositories, foundation models, and rigorous benchmarking of deconvolution methods.
synthesis: The common thread is scalable computational infrastructure for transcriptomic data: integration, annotation, deconvolution, and standardized reprocessing. LIGER2 extends iNMF-based integration to millions of cells with on-disk loading and a new embedding alignment method, while scBaseCount standardizes 10x scRNA-seq mined from the SRA across more than 502 million cells. LucaCell replaces gene IDs with mRNA sequence embeddings for cross-species annotation, and immgenT-GP defines 200 gene programs across about 800,000 mouse T cells. ImmuneLens links paired transcriptomes and TCR sequences through disentangled multimodal learning. Deconvolution is addressed by a ten-method bulk RNA-seq benchmark and by CellMAGE for multiparental populations. Pipeline work includes FORGE for snMultiome analysis and AmbientMapper for ambient chromatin contamination in scifi-ATAC-seq.
